specs_json.battery: ~41 Ah class intelligent flight battery, fast-charge

notes: China-market successor to T50 with ~25% higher spray payload (50 kg) and much faster spreading (up to 190 kg/min). Adds combined spray/spread/mapping workflows. Global availability limited.

failure_modes.name: Spreader impeller wear / jam with granular fertilizer
failure_modes.mitigation: clean spreader after each load, avoid caked/wet granules, replace impeller per wear schedule

failure_modes.name: High-rate pump seal failure
failure_modes.mitigation: run pumps only with fluid, replace seals proactively, avoid abrasive suspensions

failure_modes.name: Battery thermal stress from ultra-fast charging
failure_modes.mitigation: use OEM cooling charge cabinet, rotate multiple packs, avoid charging immediately after high-load flight

failure_modes.name: Structural fatigue at arm joints under 100kg-class TOW
failure_modes.mitigation: inspect arm locks before each session, torque-check fasteners, retire arms after hard landings

failure_modes.name: Downwash-induced radar/vision misreads in dusty spreading
failure_modes.mitigation: clean sensor windows, raise operating altitude in dusty conditions, recalibrate vision periodically
